title: An Act promoting economic development with emerging artificial intelligence models and safety
sponsor: Joint Committee on Advanced Information Technology, the Internet and Cybersecurity
committees: Joint Committee on Advanced Information Technology, the Internet and Cybersecurity
Senate Committee on Ways and Means
last_action: Reported favorably as a new draft of S.37 and referred to the Senate Committee on Ways and Means.
status: Referred to Senate Ways and Means
summary: Would regulate covered frontier models through safety and security protocols, catastrophic-risk controls, incident investigations and reporting, whistleblower protections, and enforcement by the Attorney General. It also establishes duties for large computing clusters and creates an AI innovation fund.
committee_dynamics: The joint technology committee replaced S.37 with this favorable new draft and sent it to Senate Ways and Means. It is Massachusetts's most direct pending frontier-model safety proposal in the current session.
advance_rationale: The bill received a favorable committee report but has not advanced beyond Senate Ways and Means.
verification_level: Official legislature status and bill text verified.
